question:
Which of the following numbers will replace the question mark (?) in the given series?

13, 17, 24, 36, 55, 85, 128, 188, ?
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

The logic here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/48dcc87856aeb95efe481c8c4a752fea0fe92d70376b5097a781ffb348e0264e.png] 

First, we will take out the difference as :

17 - 13 = 4

24 - 17 = 7

36 - 24 = 12

55 - 36 = 19

85 - 55 = 30

128 - 85 = 43

188 - 128 = 60

So, the logic follows here is as:

17 = 13 + 4

24 = 17 + 4 + 3 (1st prime number is added)

36 = 24 + 7 + 5 (2nd prime number is added)

55 = 36 + 12 + 7 (3rd prime number is added)

85 = 55 + 19 + 11 (4th prime number is added)

128 = 85 + 30 + 13 (5th prime number is added)

188 = 128 + 43 + 17 (6th prime number is added)

Thus, we will add the last number and the difference between the last two numbers and the 7th prime number too, we will get,

188 + 60 + 19 = 267

Hence, the missing number will be __**267**__.
